note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1952. Nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue on Tuesday 20 May 1952; contests in Bessbrook North, Camlough and Moybane, polled Thursday 5 June 1952. No nominations for Crossmaglen, Drumintee and Moyra Castle, whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. No party labels printed. Polled Thursday 5 June 1952. Clarke was the sitting member (1949). The County Armagh transcription published before 7 Nov 2026 (Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 8 ("Newry No. 2 R.D.C.")) read Peter Malachy Morris: 'Peter M. Morris'; Patrick Anthony McGeeney: 'Patrick McGeeney'; Thomas Clarke: 'Thomas Clarke'. Earlier transcription: The nominations print Morris's division as "Moybawn".
